catalysts.impact: Confirm revenue trajectory and margin trend

catalysts.event: H1 2026 results + Gulf Cement integration update
catalysts.impact: Visibility on UAE venture contribution and European demand cycle

catalysts.event: FY 2026 results + potential further M&A / solar capacity rollout
catalysts.impact: Full-year earnings power; decarbonization cost savings materializing

bull_case.narrative: European construction cycle bottoming + US infrastructure spend + UAE entry + solar energy cost advantage drive FCF compounding. Net cash position enables buybacks/M&A. Stock rerates to 7-8x EV/EBITDA from current 5.6x.
assumptions: US volumes stable at high levels
EBITDA margin expands to 28-30% from solar savings
bull_case.key_risks: Energy cost spike, EU recession, UAE integration delays

base_case.narrative: Mature cyclical compounding at mid-single-digit growth. Pricing holds but volume growth muted. Margins stable at ~26% EBITDA. FCF ~€450-500M/year funds dividend growth + modest buybacks. Stock fairly valued at 5.5-6x EV/EBITDA.
base_case.key_risks: Cement demand cyclicality, carbon cost inflation

bear_case.narrative: EU construction recession deepens; US slows. Carbon costs accelerate faster than price pass-through. UAE venture underperforms. FCF compresses to €300M. Stock de-rates to 4.5x EV/EBITDA on cyclical fears.
bear_case.key_risks: Deep EU recession, carbon price >€120/t, debt-funded M&A

valuation_framework.method: EV/EBITDA multiple on normalized EBITDA + net cash

key_risks.impact: €50-100M annual cost increase if carbon >€100/t without full pass-through
US represents ~30% of EBITDA; slowdown hits group margins

key_risks.risk: Gulf Cement integration / Middle East geopolitics
key_risks.impact: Minor EBITDA drag if project delayed
Mitigated by 93% solar coverage at Italian plants; Germany/US more exposed
